source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Fuel, p.6M-4

procedures.title: Float level: adjust (Holley 4150 center inlet and 2300)
steps: Wait about a minute for the level to settle and check again at the sight plug.
Readjust until correct, then refit the sight plug and air cleaner.
notes: For a settled secondary bowl level, open the primary throttles slightly and work the secondary throttle by hand.

procedures.title: Carburetor: additional on-engine adjustments
steps: These can be made on the engine; procedures are in Section 6M of the Overhaul Manual for the carburetor concerned.
Rochester 4MV: float, accelerator pump, idle vent, air valve, choke rod, choke vacuum break, choke unloader, secondary throttle lockout, secondary opening, secondary closing.
Holley 2300 and 4150: float, air vent valve, accelerator pump, choke vacuum break, choke unloader.

procedures.title: Carburetor: remove
steps: Take off the air cleaner and gasket.
Disconnect the fuel and vacuum lines.
Disconnect the choke rod or cable.
Disconnect the accelerator linkage.
With automatic transmission, disconnect the TV linkage.
Remove the attaching nuts and/or bolts and lift off the carburetor.
notes: Dirt, water or other contamination often causes flooding, stumble and similar complaints; remove the carburetor without draining the bowl so the fuel can be inspected during teardown.

procedures.title: Carburetor: test before installation
steps: Fill the bowl before installing, using a bench-mounted fuel pump, a little fuel and fittings; check float and inlet needle and seat operation.
Work the throttle several times and check that the pump jets discharge.
notes: A pre-filled bowl eases the load on starter and battery and reduces backfiring on start-up.

procedures.title: Carburetor: install
steps: Make sure the throttle body and manifold sealing faces are clean.
Fit a new carburetor-to-manifold flange gasket if needed.
Set the carburetor over the manifold studs.
Start the vacuum and fuel lines.
Install and tighten the nuts and/or bolts securely.
Tighten the fuel and vacuum lines.
Connect and adjust the accelerator and TV linkage.
Connect the choke rod.
Refit the air cleaner and set idle speed and mixture per the decal.

procedures.title: Carburetor inlet fuel filter: service
steps: Disconnect the fuel line at the inlet filter nut.
Unscrew the inlet filter nut from the carburetor with a 1" box wrench or socket.
Take out the element and spring (see figures 4C and 5C in the manual).
Bronze element: blow into the cone end; air must pass freely.
Paper element: blow into the fuel inlet end; if air does not pass freely, replace it.
